arguments.command:
python -c "
import threading
c = threading.Condition()
print('type:', type(c._lock))
# Try to acquire twice
c.acquire()
print('first acquire succeeded')
c.acquire()
print('second acquire succeeded')
c.release()
c.release()
print('released')
"
